question: Within a fixed limited transfer setup, does adding primary-T supervision outperform adding the same number of K562/RPE1 target-context aggregates?
status_scope: exploratory source comparison, not a fully matched broad pretraining corpus
target_universe: intersection with complete primary donor-context coverage and >=5 cells per external target; metadata/count coverage only, no effect/significance filtering
gene_universe: reference-gene intersection of all three source matrices, no HVG or DEG selection
library_normalization: sum of all raw retained genes in each published source; source retention differences disclosed
mechanism: same Reactome target annotations, no response teacher or pretrained weights
permission: P1; all target response-derived input features disabled
state_representation: fixed 32D projection of allowed controls plus a fixed 3D hash of the literal context name; identical construction across both source regimes
tuning_and_budget: same selection/calibration hash and training budget as experiment_plan_frozen.json
interpretation_limit: These unmatched factors prevent attributing a difference solely to immune relevance or fully satisfying the original broad-data matching aim.
